Home.IntroParagraph1: I enjoy turning ideas into real products. I build things end-to-end, from mobile applications to backend services.
Home.IntroParagraph2: I develop mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript, and work on APIs and system integrations on the backend side.
Home.IntroParagraph3: I run my own self-hosted Linux server environment. I love exploring new technologies and applying what I learn to real projects.

About.Heading: Get to know me!
About.Paragraph: Hi, my name is Ahmet Güneş. I'm a Computer Engineering graduate with a focus on building mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript, while also being strongly interested in backend systems and infrastructure. I completed mobile and software development internships at Akbank, IsTechSoft, and Samsun Atakum Municipality, where I gained hands-on experience working on real-world applications and development workflows. I'm open to new opportunities, collaborations, and projects where I can contribute, learn, and grow. Feel free to reach out — you can find my links in the footer.

Projects.Heading: My Projects
Projects.WigglesDesc: An innovative pet management web app enabling pet parents to create unique pet IDs, securely store and share vaccination records, and generate QR codes for pet profiles, enhancing safety.
Projects.NewsletterDesc: A newsletter signup site made using Mailchimp API where the signups can be monitored from the MailChimp account. This project was made to understand API integration, environment variables and vercel deployment.
Projects.RogFreeDesc: A website that shows you over seven specialized yoga postures for specific diseases or health problems. This was a group project made in a team of two for a 36-hour-long online hackathon named Hackodisha 2.0.
Projects.TindogDesc: This website is a landing page of Tinder but for dogs. It is a responsive website which was made to understand Bootstrap. I also learned how to host my project on Github and then how to deploy that project using Github pages.
